main.description: Recommending a thread or a post, like an upvote, or voting it down. Forked from site.standard.graph.recommend. One per author per subject: if there are several, the newest counts. Changing a vote updates the record in place, and withdrawing it deletes the record.

subject.description: The community.lexicon.thread.thread or community.lexicon.thread.post being recommended.

direction.description: up recommends the subject, down votes it down. Absent means up, so a plain recommend stays a standard.site-style recommend. Apps that don't rank by votes may ignore down votes.
